# Talkpal

> Talkpal is an AI-powered language learning platform featuring TutorsGPT technology that provides personalized tutoring through speech recognition, natural language processing, and adaptive learning algorithms.

The platform combines artificial intelligence, machine learning, and NLP to deliver personalized language education with features like pronunciation mastery, real-time feedback, and adaptive learning paths. Talkpal offers both free and Premium tiers to help learners achieve fluency through innovative AI-driven tutoring.
